source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Guys, for

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: the arrival of the Senate President, the Presiding Officer of the Impeachment Court, and the Senator Judges.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Sergeant-at-Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Panfilo Lacson.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Let us all pause for one minute of silent prayer for humility, wisdom, neutrality, and fairness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call of members. The Honorable Senator Judge Aquino, Senator Judge Cayetano Allan, Senator Judge Cayetano Pia, Senator Judge De La Rosa, Atty. Ersito, Atty. Goh, Atty. Ontiveros, Atty. Lacson, Atty. Lapid, Atty. Legarda, Atty. Marcoleta, Atty. Marcos, Atty. Padilla, Atty. Pangilinan, Atty. Soto III, Atty. Tulfo Erwin, Atty. Raffi, Atty. Villanueva Setor Judge Villar Camille, Setor Judge Villar Marc, Setor Judge Zubiri, The Presiding Officer Setor Judge Escudero, Senate President De Chalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 20 senators present, the Chair declares the presence of a quorum. In accordance with the rules of procedure on impeachment trials, the Chair now recognizes the newly elected Presiding Officer to preside over the proceedings of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you Mr. Senate President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The chair would like to defer action or approval on the journal as we await the manifestations of some of our senator judges. However, having said that, before we end today's trial, regardless of the submission of the senator judges who manifested their intention to submit their manifestations, we will have to approve the journal already so that we can furnish the parties with a copy As requested by council for the respondents, they would want an official copy of yesterday's ruling in order to afford them sufficient time to avail of whatever remedies they may want to seek in regard to the ruling in whole or in part. So for the information of the council for the parties, we shall be approving the journal within the day. You shall have a copy of the same before today's trial ends. This is also to inform the senator judges to make their submissions At the soonest possible time otherwise it shall only be made part of the transcript and the records and will no longer be made part of the journal so ordered and for the information of the body the clerk of court will please call the

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case No. 004-2026, in the matter of the Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: appearances of the parties please good

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: afternoon your honors same appearance for the prosecution We are ready for the presentation of our next witness, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Appearances for the respondent. Good afternoon, Your Honors. Same appearance for the defense.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: May we know who on the part of the counsel, rather, who among the panel of prosecutors or counsel from the panel of prosecutors will be presenting the witness?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: This representation, Your Honor, will be presenting the next witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: May I know, likewise, on the part of the counsel for respondents, who will be standing on the other side? Will it be

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: you, Atty. Villanueva?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: That's correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed. Lead Prosecutor, call your first witness.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honors, we are calling to the witness stand our next witness, the last witness for Article IV, Threat, Atty. Melvin Matibag, NBI Director.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kindly remain standing, Director Matibag. The clerk will kindly administer the oath to the witness.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kindly turn on the mic of the clerk of court. You, Melvin

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Melvin A. Matibag, do you swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Kindly sit down, Director Matibag.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Before the lead prosecutor proceeds with their direct examinations, the chair would like to address the witness regarding certain matters.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Director Matibag, the chair would like to remind and admonish you on behalf of the impeachment court to kindly avoid statements appertaining to individual members of this impeachment court. Without prejudice to any investigation you are undertaking, you may do so. But without need of issuing statements that may impinge upon the independence and or integrity of the court or the individual senator judges. And for this reason, for your information as well, Atty. Director Matibag, the statements made by Senators, Senator Judge Alan Peter Cayetano and Senator Judge Pia Cayetano last July 15 pertaining to statements made by you and the video presented in the impeachment court shall be referred to the Senate as a legislative body and referred to the appropriate committee, specifically the Rules Committee, for its proper disposition and for the matter to be taken up thereat and not in this impeachment court. I hope you will adhere and understand, Director Matibag, the reminder and the admonition of the Chair.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Director Matibag. Lead Prosecutor, the Honorable Luistro, you may proceed with your direct examination.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor. We are offering the testimony of witness, NBI Director, Atty. Melvin Matibag, to prove the following. One, siya ang kasalukuyang director ng National Bureau of Investigation. Two, matapos siyang italaga bilang director, may binuo siyang Special Task Force para magsagawa ng investigasyon.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: May karagdagang investigasyon na isinagawa ang Special Task Force hinggil sa mga pagbabantang ginawa sa buhay ng Pangulo kasama ang pagbabanta ng Vice Presidente. 4. Ang pagbanta sa buhay ng Pangulo ay hindi lamang pagbanta sa kanyang buhay.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Ang mga natuklasan at naging risulta ng Special Task Force mula sa karagdagang imbistigasyon 6. Kilalanin at patunayan ang mga dokumento kaugnay ng nasabing imbistigasyon ng NBI 7. Ang iba pang mga bagay

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Comments, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, as to the first purpose, we are willing to stipulate, Your Honor, that Atty. Matib is the current NBI Director. In the interest of expediting the proceedings, no need to propound questions on that. Number two, as to the task force, Your Honor, we would have to object. On the basis of them being irrelevant, your honor would just like to manifest for the record that such task force, your honor, was not part of the articles of impeachment as well as the impeachment complaint. There was no mention thereof, and this is tantamount to a new information. So your honor would just like to manifest for the record that the articles of impeachment is Akin to a information that is filed in court and the trials already started and the prosecution cannot modify such information or articles of impeachment for such will be a violation of our client's right to due process particularly her right to be promptly and fully apprised of the exact charge against her so any information any new information is irrelevant number three Same objection, Your Honor, because the Good Counsel mentioned karagdagang investigation. So it pertains also to a new information which is irrelevant. Number four, we would have to object because the Good Counsel used the word banta, which is a conclusion of fact. She mentioned it twice. So we are objecting on the basis of it being conclusions of fact. Number 5, as to the special task force, same objection, Your Honor, considering that, again, there was no mention of such information, new information in the articles of impeachment. Numbers 6 and 7 are okay, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Would the lead prosecutor care to respond?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: We would like to respond, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The lady may proceed.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Later,

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, we will present that this Special Task Force was specifically created For the purpose of furthering the investigation because of the possibility of seeing na hindi po mag-isa ang vicepresidente sa bantang ito. In other words, Your Honor, the mention of special task force including its creation at ang karagdagang investigasyon nito passes the test. As a matter of fact, this is the very reason why we are presenting Atty. Melvin Matibag, the NBI Director before the Honorable Impeachment Court. Your Honor, the defense likewise mentioned that Special Task Force was not mentioned in the articles of impeachment.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: The decision of the Impeachment Court yesterday was based on documents which pertain to acts and omissions prior to 2022 and acts or omissions which were not specifically mentioned in the articles of impeachment. What is important here, Your Honor, are the allegations or testimonies to be presented.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: It is not necessary that they be specifically mentioned in the articles of impeachment. Finally, Your Honor, they likewise raise the issue of due process of the respondent. It is very much apparent, Your Honor, since day one of our impeachment trial, the respondent is very well represented by her very much able defense panel. In other words, Your Honor, atin pong ibinibigay ang nararapat na due process sa Respondent Vice President. And as far as this impeachment trial is concerned, kasama na po ang pagtistigo ni NBI Director kaugnay ng Special Task Force and all those who were involved in this investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Chair reminds the lead prosecutor to skip the introduction and preliminary questions with respect to the witness being the current NBI director, having been admitted by the counsel for respondent. Insofar as the phrase banta is concerned, Chair would like to remind the senator judges that that is indeed a conclusion which the prosecutors will seek to prove for our purposes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Tawagin na lamang natin o ituring na lamang natin ang mga pahayag ang binitiwan ng ikalawang Pangulo. But Lead Prosecutor, kindly let the witness testify and characterize it as such if he will, but it should come from the witness and not from any of the counsel for the parties. As to the task force, the task force was formed on April 16, 2026 after the impeachment complaints have been filed. Although the impeachment complaint was filed before the Senate in May, the impeachment complaints were already filed prior to the formation of the task force. And as a last point, this, if at all, would show persistence, absence or lack of it, which is an element of the crime of grave threats which the prosecution is seeking to prove. Again, not through their statements, but through the witnesses they will be presenting in the person today.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Chair will therefore allow the testimony and the counsel for the respondent may object at any time with respect to the points he raised in the Chair will rule. Each time an objection is raised regarding that matter without prejudice. I'm already seeing what Atty. Vinluan will do because he's reaching for the mic. Without prejudice to the counsel of course making a continuing objection with respect to his observations to the offer. So that we would abbreviate the proceedings and we won't need to object each time if at all it is brought up. Would that be correct, attorney?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. We register our continuing objection and everything subject to cross-examination.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Noted. The lead prosecutor may proceed. Your witness.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr. Witness, please state your name, age, and other details.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ako po si Atty. Melvin Matibag, na kasalukuyang Director ng National Bureau of Investigation. Ang amin pong tanggapan ay may address na 9th floor, Filinvest Cyberzone Bay, Building C, Diosdado Macapagal Boulevard, Pasay City.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Nabanggit mo na ikaw ay isang abogado. Gaano ka na katagal sa nasabing propesyon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: 29 years po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Saan ka nagtapos ng iyong abogasya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sa Ateneo Law School po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Bago ang iyong abogasya, ano ang una mong inaral sa kolehiyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ako po ay nagtapos ng Bachelor of Arts, Major in Philosophy, sa University of Santo Tomas.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Pagkatapos naman ng abogasya, Mr. Witness, ano ang iyong inaral kung mayroon man?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Nag-aral po ako ng Masters of Law, Major in Corporate and Finance Law, sa Wayne State University, Detroit, Michigan, USA po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: You are here as NBI Director. Bago ka itinalaga bilang NBI Director, ano ang iyong mga naging trabaho, kung mayroon man?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Bago po ako itinalaga bilang NBI Director ay kasalukuyan po akong naglilingkod bilang dean o dekano ng Lyceum of Alabang College of Law.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Nabanggit mo na ikaw ay dating dean ng Lyceum of Alabang College of Law. Bukod sa pagiging dean, ano pa, kung mayroon man, ang iyong naging trabaho bago ang iyong pagkatalaga bilang NBI Director?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ako po ay nanungkulan na rin sa iba't ibang kapasidad sa ilalim po ng iba't ibang administrasyon. Una-una po rito, bilang director ng Laguna Lake Development Authority sa administrasyon po ng dating Pangulong Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Nabanggit mo na ikaw ay naglingkod bilang director ng Laguna Lake Development Authority panahon ng dating Pangulong Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo. Ano pa, Mr. Witness, kung mayroon man, ang iyong naging trabaho bago ka itinalaga bilang NBI Director?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sa administrasyon po ng dating Pangulong Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, ako rin po ay nanungkulan bilang General Manager ng Manila International Airport Authority. At sa administrasyon din po ng dating Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte, ako rin po ay nanungkulan sa iba't ibang kapasidad po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: mentioned that under the administration of President Duterte, you also served in the government. Ano itong mga posisyon mo sa gobyerno na iyong nabanggit?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Relevance.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, may I respond? Counsel may answer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel may respond, rather.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: The prosecution, Your Honor, is establishing the competence of the witness, the qualification as an official of the government. We are establishing, Your Honor, that he is loyal to his duty. Regardless of the principal, he is serving.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Wind up with your preliminaries, Council. Witness may answer. Objection overruled.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. I have been appointed as President and CEO of National Transmission Corporation from January 2017 until March 2022. After that, I was appointed as Cabinet Secretary of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Witness, Bilang NBI Director, ano ang iyong mga responsibilidad at kapangyarihan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Director, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Did you stipulate, counsel, as well as with the powers and responsibilities of—

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: We're willing to stipulate, Your Honor, as what the law provides.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, regardless of the position of the defense to stipulate on the fact pertaining to the powers and responsibilities of the NBI Director, it is the position of the prosecution that since this is a constitutional process, Mahalaga po na marinig ng ating mga iginagalang na senator judges. Ganon din ng mga kababayang nanonood kung ano talaga ang responsibilidad at kapangyarihan ng isang NBI director.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Understood, counsel. But it has been stipulated already by counsel for the respondents. So kindly go straight to the matter at the soonest possible time. You're in a short leash with respect to the preliminaries on the qualifications of the witness. Kindly proceed, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr. Witness?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Ano ang iyong mga kapangyarihan at responsibilidad kung iyong nalalaman?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ang kasama po rito sa aking mga responsibilidad, ang una-una na po, we are the primary investigating authority ng ating pong mansa. Kung kaya po, ito po ay aming mandato na mag-imbestiga sa anumang usapin o mga maaaring kribe na pumapasok sa amin. At kasama rin po rito ang pagbabalangkas ng mga pulisiya. Pagbubuo ng mga units or divisions kung kinakailangan at ang pag-management po administratively po ng aming opisina.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Sa mga kapangyarihan at responsibilidad na iyong binanggit, ano ang araw-araw mong ginagampanan, kung mayroon man at kung iyong nalalaman?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ang araw-araw pong pagbabantay at pakikipag-ugnayan sa aming mga ahente dahil po sa araw-araw naming pag-ibistiga. Ang iba't iba pong usapin na pumapasok po sa aming ahensya.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Kaugnay pa rin ng mga binanggit mong kapagyarihan at responsibilidad. Ano ang pinakamabigat mo na responsibilidad bilang NBI Director kung iyong nalalaman?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Calls for an opinion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Witness may answer. I think witness is competent enough to answer that question.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Ang akin pong hindi lamang po bilang primary investigating agency kundi ang aming pong primerong ginagawa ay ang pagbabantay para po sa ating mga taong bayan at bantayan din po na ang ating konstitusyon ay may patupad at siguraduhin na hindi po nagkakaroon ng kaguluhan at ligalig para po ito po ay puksain, habulin at amin pong Ang mga taong lumalabag po sa aming pong mandatong binabantayan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Bukod sa ang respondent ay ang vicepresidente, ano pa kung mayroon man ang pagkakakinanlan ng respondent sa impeachment trial na ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Basi po sa aking mandato bilang director nang ako po ay pumasok sa abing opisina, lahat po ng mga kasong nakabimbin at mga amin na naipasok sa Department of Justice ay akin pong nirebisa at tinignan upang akin po itong masubaybayan. At isa po sa mga kasong aking nakita rito, ang respondent po rito ay ang ating pong vicepresidente kung saan po siya ay kinasuhan ng aming Cybercrime Division ng Grave threat at inciting to sedition na sa kasalukuyan po ngayong nakabindihin sa Department of Justice.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Nabanggit mo na ang respondent ay may kasong grave threat at inciting to sedition sa DOJ? Mr. Witness, ano pa kung mayroon man ang pagkakakilanlan ng respondent sa impeachment trial na ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ang ating pong vicepresidente, kasalukuyang ating pong subject sa ating continuing investigation, Mr.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Witness, may binanggit ka na continuing investigation ng NBI. Ano ang iyong ginawa kung mayroon man kaugnay ng ongoing investigation ng NBI na iyong binanggit?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sa papamagitan ng pag-create po ng isang administrative order kung saan bumalangkas po tayo ng mga miyembro ng aming pong opisina para sila po ang mag-tuloy ng investigasyon na ito at mag-monitor po ng mga kailangan gawin.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Kaugnay pa rin ng binanggit mong Special Task Force. Ano ang kahalagahan nito sa investigasyon na ginagawa ng National Bureau of Investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Napakahalaga po para sa amin sapagkat na from our law enforcement perspective ang ginawa pong banta ng vicepresidente ay tinatrato na naming hindi banta kundi isang plano para po sa pagpatay sa ating Pangulo and that is a threat to the President which we consider also na threat po sa ating national security.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr. Witness, anong katunayan mayroon ka kaugnay ng iyong binanggit na binuong Special Task Force upang mag-imbestiga sa lahat ng banta sa buhay ng Presidente, kasama na ang pagbabanta ng Vice Presidente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Meron po akong in-issue na Administrative Order No. 11 noong April 16 ng kasalukuyang taon po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: At kung ipapakita sa iyo ang kopya ng Administrative Order No. 11, ito ba ay makikilala mo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Honor, may we request that AO number 11, previously marked as Exhibit P429, be flushed. We likewise request, Your Honor, that Atty. Kyle Capunan, Assisting Counsel, be allowed to approach the witness. For confirmation of the document.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Assisting counsel for the prosecution may approach. And likewise, assisting counsel for the respondent may approach to confirm and validate the document being shown to the witness. Likewise, the text through the clerk of court is instructed to kindly flash in the screens the document being referred to by the lead prosecutor, the Honorable Luistro.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Kindly zoom it in, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr. Witness. Your Honor, Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Honor, can we be given

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: time to comment?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, we manifest, for the record, Your Honor, that the document is a photocop.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: So noted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thus, the lead prosecutor confirmed the observation of counsel for respondent while we are awaiting their review of the document.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, after the confirmation of the document, the prosecution will be requesting for the transfer of marking to a certified true copy, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: At the later time?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Noted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel may proceed when she's ready.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr. Witness, ipinapakita sa iyo ngayon. May we request the assisting counsel to please show the document to the witness?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Kapunan, kindly.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Mr. Witness, ipinapakita sa iyo ngayon ang isang dokumento na may pamagat na Administrative Order No. 11. Ano ang kaugnayan nito sa binanggit mo kanina na Administrative Order No. 11 na kung saan nabuo ang Special Task Force?

turns.text: I later called up retired senior police Sonny Buenaventura and relayed to him Colonel Ronald Bato de la Rosa's abduction operation ordered to me as allegedly ordered to him by Mayor Inday Sara Duterte Carpio. Pero nung iyan po ay aming sinusuri din, yung binabanggit ninyo po na Romanov, I think that was the January 18, 2024 na pahayag po ni Mayor Baste Duterte kung saan sinabi niya: ‘Let me tell you this, Mr. Bongbong Marcos.’ Hindi ko lang po maano yung exact words, but I remember that 'Before you go to sleep, remember the Romanovs and the Mussolinis and what happened to the Marcos family in 1986.' Yun po yung nakita nati na isa na nagli-link po diyan sa Romanov. Kaya recently narinig ko rin po yung dating director na sinasabi niya na ang Oplan Romanov ay tunay na banta sa pamilya ng mga Marcoses at hindi po kay Vice President Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So base po sa imbestigasyon ng NBI, ang Oplan Romanov po ba ay banta sa buhay ng Presidente o sa buhay ng Vice Presidente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Kaya po merong kaming task force kasama po yan sa aming continuing surveillance at active investigation po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: May actionable intelligence po ba ang NBI na posibleng patuloy pa rin ang panganib sa buhay ng Presidente doon sa linyang iyon ng inyong imbestigasyon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po yan sapagkat... Pinanggit ko nga po kanina yung ginagamit sa National Threat Assessment Center po ng Secret Service ng Amerika, ay pumapasok po doon yung mga observation na iyan. At katunayan po, lalo pang lumawig o lumawak yung mga banta sa presidente, namin pong namumonitor. Pati po ang mga ordinaryong tao ngayon ay napakadali po na magbigay ng banta. At para sa amin po, hindi lang naman po yung banta sa ating Pangulong ang aming binabandayan kundi yung pong bandayan natin ang kaligtasan ng ating mga kababayan at isiguraduhin natin na ang democratic process po ay umiiral sa atin base sa ating pong Constitution po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At sa kabilang banda naman po, may actionable intelligence din po ba ang NBI na may totoong banta sa buhay naman ng Vice Presidente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Sa ngayon po, Hindi po namin tinitingnan kung totoo may actionable intel, pero base po sa aming mandato, kasama po sa mandato namin na proteksyonan po ang siguridad ng Pangulo, ng Vice Presidente, ng Senate President, ng Speaker of the House at Chief Justice. Kaya kung wala man pong task force, tuloy-tuloy naman po ang aming pagpamonitor dito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Pero sa ngayon, kung isusuma po natin: may actionable intelligence na may patuloy na panganib sa buhay ng Presidente, pero wala pang actionable intelligence na may banta din naman sa buhay ng Vice Presidente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Malinaw po iyon sapagkat lumabas lang naman po iyon doon sa sinasabi nitong si Princess Maui.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Risa Hontiveros. Next to interject and make his interventions would be our Senate President, Sherwin Gatchalian. He is recognized. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Tama po ba, Director Matibag, na after one year and eight months, wala pang nakikita ang NBI na nakontratang papatay?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yan po ang ating kukunin na informasyon pa sa ating mga persons of interest na ating sinusurveillance. Katunayan po as we speak, tuloy-tuloy po yung ating pakikipag-usap. Pati po doon sa mga malalapit sa taong aking binabanggit. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So tuloy-tuloy pa ngayon ang inyong investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ngayon nakita ko na bumuo kayo ng task force. At task force? Temporary in nature lang yan, di ba? Kailangan matatapos ang inyong investigasyon? Dahil nga nasabi ko one year and eight months na ito, ngayon may bagong task force. So kailang matatapos itong investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Ito po ay matatapos finally pag atin pong na-locate specifically ang taong kausap ng Vice Presidente. At ito naman pong task force, bukod po sa seguridad ng Presidente, we are also guarding po na walang gulo, na yung mga destabilization ay atin ding mab...

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: I cannot give the exact time, but the task force was established on April 16, and it's doing a great progress po. So sa palagay ko po, malapit na rin natin itong mahanap, itong taong ating tinutukoy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.text: Thank you, Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo. Senator-Judge Pangilinan is recognized. You may proceed with your intervention, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Magandang gabi, ginoong direktor. Kanina tinatanong sa inyo yung usapin ng trust rating, na mas mataas yung trust rating ng Vice President kaysa sa President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Bilang abogado, Ang tinanong sa iyo ito kanina. May kinalaman ba ang approval sa trust? Kung mas mataas ang trust rating, ibig sabihin wala nang betrayal of the public trust?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Well, wala po. Sapagkat sabi ko nga sa akin pong pananaw, sa akin din pong kaunting eksperyensa bilang isang political advisor din po, eh yung ating mga survey is only a snapshot.

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Pagkakaroon po tayo ng problema sapagkat ang mangyayari sa atin dyan, yung tinitingnan pala natin ay yung numero. At without accusing anyone, alam naman natin there are surveys that can be manipulated po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: But having said that, kaya ako lang tinanong yun kasi baka yung mga nakikinig nating mga kababayan ay malito dahil hindi ba tamang sabihin na iba yung trust rating, iba yung betrayal of the public trust?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Tama po. Yung trust rating po ay base sa numero dahil sa survey. Yung betrayal of public trust, malinaw naman po iyan na nakasaad sa Constitution na ito ay isang basehan ng impeachment. At saan po pumapasok ang betrayal of public trust? Pag meron ka pong ginawa na pag-violate, not necessarily criminal. Hindi kailangan ng conviction. Pag tinignan natin yung discussion po ng ating Constitutional Committee nang ginawa iyan, binabanggit nga po diyan yung betrayal of public trust: yung hindi mo pagtupad sa iyong oath of office. That will qualify as a betrayal of public trust. In other words, negative yung trust rating mo o 100% yung trust rating mo, base sa batas, base sa Constitution, pwede kang ma-convict whether negative or positive trust rating; pwede ka pa ring ma-convict o ma-acquit depende sa ebidensya sa usapin ng betrayal of the public trust. Wala pong kinalaman ang survey on the trust rating kundi kung ano po ang ebidensya na ipinasok po sa ating impeachment court. Maraming salamat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Pia Cayetano is recognized for her interjections and interventions. You may proceed ma'am when you are ready and you have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: For the prosecution, do you consider Lascañas a witness for you?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: With all respect, Your Honor, the purpose of the testimony is to present what transpired during the investigation of the Special Task Force. As to whether or not what probative value it holds, it is not part actually of the decision of the prosecution. What we are intending to do here is to present only what happened during the investigation of the NBI, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, the Rules of Evidence are very clear. You either present a witness who provides your testimony or you present a document. And in terms of documents, Rule 132, Section 19 says there are two classes of documents: public documents and private documents. Included in public documents are documents acknowledged before a notary public. Yung pinakitang document is not acknowledged by a notary public. Pwede naman din ang private documents—that's the other class—if it can be shown and authenticated in any of the following manner: the person saw the document executed or written. Nakita ba ng witness mo na sinulat iyon? Nakita ba niya?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Your Honor, we can...

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Please answer my question.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: The next manner of authenticating: by evidence of the genuineness of the signature or handwriting of the maker. The defense said walang original signature doon. Do you disagree with that?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Okay, so simple lang, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: They're trying to prove something by showing a document that any law student, even yung mga kababayan natin na nakikinig na ngayon na ang daming alam sa procedure, will tell you na hindi acceptable iyon. And with all due respect, katulad din nung kahapon na humingi ako ng payo sa inyo, again, I will not name names. We had a discussion in caucus na you cannot unsee what you see; you cannot unhear what you hear.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: May I respond, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Not really. I don't believe there was a question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Because I already asked you the questions and you had a chance to respond.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, I—

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: There was no question posed. I was telling the lead prosecutor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: I move to my next point, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Our jurisprudence is very clear. A witness must be competent and credible. Hindi ko na babasahin lahat yung jurisprudence natin diyan dahil kumpleto na yung record natin diyan. But there is also included in our rules, Rule 132 on the Rules of Evidence. And I'll read it: a witness may be impeached by the party against whom he or she was called by contradictory evidence, by evidence that his or her general reputation for truth, honesty, or integrity is bad.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Or by evidence that he or she has made at other times statements inconsistent with his or her present testimony.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: So this is the rules, no siguro we can, well I'm reading the rules so we can take notice of this that this is what our rules say and I don't think anyone will contradict that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Again, there are lots of cases supporting this.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: So, I

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: just want to point out, Mr. President, that just looking for my notes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Sorry with the indulgences of the body. I'm just looking for my notes because I want to be accurate in the next statement that I'm going to read into the record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: If the lady cannot locate it, she may avail of her time again tomorrow since Director Matibag and the counsel for the parties will be here tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Pwede naman, but if you give me a few more seconds, I might be able to dispose of this issue, Mr. President—Mr. Presiding Officer. Okay, I won't delay. I can paraphrase it, but I think it would be best if I look at the record, so I will just avail.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Presiding Officer will give the lady first crack at interventions by a Senator-Judge tomorrow after the cross-examination of counsel for respondent. Since Director Matibag will be here again tomorrow for the continuation of cross-examination, the interjections and interventions of the other Senator-Judges may proceed again after the cross-examination, redirect, and recross, if any.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, aside from the Las Cañas document, we would also like to request a copy of the AO number 11. Just for reference, Your Honor, to be used as AO number 11.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The prosecutor is directed to furnish—

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Can we do that after the proceedings, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Within the day after the proceedings, a copy of AO No. 11, signed by Director Matibag, dated, if I'm not mistaken, April 16, 2026.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Any other points you want to raise, lead prosecutor?

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: It appears that there is a standing subpoena for

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Ms. Marivic-Pareja of

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Legislative Archive. We manifested yesterday that we have yet to determine when we will be presenting this witness. We will act

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: on these at the proper time. This will be part of the chair's ruling before we adjourn.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: May I inquire, Your Honor, if tomorrow we will be able to conclude the testimony of witness Director Matibag, whether or not we will be proceeding to present the first witness for confidential fund, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The court will address that in a bit before we adjourn, counsel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Any other points, counsel or the respondent?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: No more, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Court will now dispose of some administrative matters.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: We are in receipt of a request for subpoena at testificandum addressed to Ms. Marivic Pareja as well as subpoena at testificandum addressed to Mr. Roderick C. Wamil and Ms. Aileen May Del Ocampo, both from the Commission on Audit. The Chair, the Presiding Officer, the first action on these requests for subpoena and will act on them at the proper time and in due time. In regard to the subpoena, ad testificandum, and do sestecom issued to Ms. Violeta Constantino and Ms. Nanita Camposano, the Chair in the meantime recalls the subpoenas issued to them.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Without prejudice to reissuing the subpoena at a later time for a later date. Para po sa kalaman, ang dalawang sinabpoena ng Senado nito bilang impeachment court na si Ginang o Binibining Violeta Constantino, Ginang o Binibining Nanita Campuzano, hindi niya po kailangan magpunta dito sa hukuman bukas.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Binabawi pong pansamantala ng hukumang ito ang sapinang in-issue para sa inyo. At mag-i-issue na lamang po kami ng panibagong sapina kung kailan po kayo kinakailangan magpunta o magtungo dito sa impeachment court sa Senado. What is the pleasure of Senator Judge Zubiri?

turns.speaker: Sen. Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri
turns.text: Thank you very much, Presiding Officer. Just want to ask a question. You are withdrawing the subpoena because you feel that we might not take them up tomorrow, is that correct?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Yes, that is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri
turns.text: Habang pa ba ito kay witness Atiba? You mean we cannot take it up tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: I would think so. That was pursuant to a discussion with both counsel for the parties earlier. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri
turns.text: we're looking at taking up that article on Monday?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Yes, that is correct, Your Honor. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri
turns.text: thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Also, in regard to the trial,

turns.speaker: Sen. Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri
turns.text: Tuesday pala po. Tuesday. Sorry. Monday is the sauna. So Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Tuesday. I will discuss that too, Senator-Judge Zubiri. During caucus, the Senator-Judges agreed that next week there will be no trial on Monday, given that it's the State of the Nation Address of the President. There will be no trial on Tuesday to afford the minority the opportunity to prepare and deliver their Contra-SONA. So our next trial date, which we will clarify tomorrow, will be on July 29. On July 29, again as agreed in caucus by the senators and Senator-Judges, the new time of the trial will be from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., and the session of the Senate will be at 4 p.m.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Henceforth, after that week in August, we will be conducting the trial from Monday to Wednesday from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Council for the Parties are asked to take note.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: To avoid confusion, Director Matibag, we expect you to come back and be here again tomorrow, not at 10, but at 2 p.m., to continue with your testimony via the cross-examination, redirect or recross of counsel for the parties, and questions from the Senator-Judges. Without issuing a subpoena, Director Matibag, do we get your commitment to be here tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Atty. Melvin Matibag
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, gladly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much. There being no other matters to be taken up and no other business to take up, the trial is hereby adjourned until tomorrow, Wednesday, July 22, at 2 p.m. in the afternoon.
